dossiers.label: The puppets of the gods
dossiers.about: Each of us is a divine puppet, made as the gods' plaything or for some serious purpose. Our feelings are cords that pull us opposite ways; we should follow always one cord, the golden and sacred pull of reasoning, called the common law of the city, which is soft and needs helpers against the hard iron ones.

passage.start_quote: θαῦμα μὲν ἕκαστον ἡμῶν ἡγησώμεθα τῶν ζῴων θεῖον
passage.end_quote: τῆς γε νῦν διατριβῆς ἄξιον γίγνηται

parts.label: A divine puppet, a plaything or something serious
parts.quote: εἴτε ὡς παίγνιον ἐκείνων εἴτε ὡς σπουδῇ τινι συνεστηκός

parts.label: Feelings are cords that pull us
parts.quote: οἷον νεῦρα ἢ σμήρινθοί τινες ἐνοῦσαι σπῶσίν τε ἡμᾶς

parts.label: The golden and sacred cord of reasoning
parts.quote: τὴν τοῦ λογισμοῦ ἀγωγὴν χρυσῆν καὶ ἱεράν

parts.label: Called the common law of the city

echoes.why: Later in the Laws: man is a plaything of god, and that is the best thing about him.

related.why: Another image of the soul pulled different ways.
Gold again marks the best element in us.

dossiers.label: Soul is older than body (Laws X)
dossiers.about: Against the atheists, who make soul later than the elements: of the kinds of motion, the one that moves itself must be first and eldest; and self-motion is just what we call soul. So soul is the first cause of becoming, older than body, and the heavens are ruled by soul, best soul.

passage.start_quote: ὃ πρῶτον γενέσεως καὶ φθορᾶς αἴτιον ἁπάντων
passage.end_quote: τούτοις μὲν τοίνυν ἡμῖν τὸ λόγων τέλος ἐχέτω

parts.label: They made the first cause later
parts.quote: τοῦτο οὐ πρῶτον ἀλλὰ ὕστερον ἀπεφήναντο εἶναι γεγονὸς

parts.label: Self-motion the eldest and mightiest change
What moves itself is what we call soul
parts.quote: τὸ ἑαυτὸ κινεῖν φῂς λόγον ἔχειν τὴν αὐτὴν οὐσίαν, ἥνπερ τοὔνομα ὃ δὴ πάντες ψυχὴν προσαγορεύομεν

echoes.why: The Phaedrus: what is ever-moving is immortal.

related.why: The Timaeus' soul of the world, older than its body.
